title: Corn: trade a later harvest for less field work
applies_when: Food reserves cover a long wait and the growing season is long enough.
approach: Shift part of production to corn to reduce repeated sowing and harvesting labor. Keep a faster crop or other food source while waiting.
Schedule the harvest before cold weather and leave hauling time. A large yield that rots in the field is not a reserve.
Avoid switching every field at once: a cold snap or failed harvest can wipe out the expected supply.
verify: Reserve nutrition, actual growth conditions, remaining season and harvest labor.
reconsider: Food is already short or winter will arrive before maturity.
